scope: Factory-created CustomAgent stream completion and same-owner cleanup retry only

unitBefore.actual: consumer received terminal while original exclusive invocation remained in_flight=1

ordering.cause: The actual RPC answer and validated remote terminal were known, but original exclusive lease release depended on a separate connection task. The terminal consumer immediately called same-child AgentClose and could conflict with its own completed invocation.
ordering.fix: Within the already-existing two-fact terminal gate, synchronously drop the same retained invocation lease before exposing terminal. Existing collector retains responsibility for caller-drop and true connection EOF.
negativeCoverage: Pending actual RPC answer still holds the original child exclusive lease
Missing valid remote terminal holds the original child exclusive lease
A wrong-generation terminal cannot release the original lease

before.actual: same original owner returned its first failed AgentClose acknowledgement forever; later retry callers made no new RPC, physical calls remained 1

retryOwner.fix: Use the same once-only cleanup owner to cache successful cleanup only. A failed acknowledgement remains an error and preserves the child address; explicit retry invokes cleanup, concurrent successful callers coalesce, and repeats after success perform no extra RPC.

authority: Original framework ExtensionInvocationAuthority and SDK HandleRegistry/factory origin remain the sole invocation/identity authorities. No new public API, wire schema, scheduler, timeout or language contract.
documentation: Existing SDK Factory cleanup/retry statement clarified; no API examples or branding website changes are needed. Existing native Factory examples and scenarios remain final full-language gate inputs.
